Conflicting Capability 1: Write and commit application code to feature branches
Conflicting Capability 2: Approve own pull requests to main branch and trigger production deployments
Conflict Type: Develop & Deploy - no independent oversight of code promoted to production
Compensating Control: None - branch protection rules not enforced on 6 repositories (see DEV-03)

Conflicting Capability 1: Create new vendors in the Accounts Payable system
Conflicting Capability 2: Process and approve payments to vendors
Conflict Type: Vendor Setup & Payment Authorization - risk of fictitious vendor fraud
Compensating Control: Supervisor review is required but inconsistently applied; no system-enforced workflow for dual approval

Conflicting Capability 1: Provision new user accounts and assign access rights in Okta and AWS
Conflicting Capability 2: Modify or delete audit log entries in CloudWatch and CloudTrail
Conflict Type: Access Provisioning & Audit Log Control - ability to create access and cover tracks
Compensating Control: None - no role restriction preventing IT Admin from accessing logging configuration

Conflicting Capability 1: Access and query production employee data in RDS and Snowflake
Conflicting Capability 2: Modify or disable audit logging configuration for database activity
Conflict Type: Data Access & Log Tampering - ability to access sensitive data and suppress evidence
Compensating Control: Quarterly security review of DBA access; CloudTrail captures some API-level activity

Conflicting Capability 1: Create new employee records and establish payroll parameters in HRIS
Conflicting Capability 2: Approve payroll runs in the payroll processing module
Conflict Type: Data Entry & Authorization - risk of fictitious employee or ghost payroll fraud
Compensating Control: Dual approval for payroll runs is partially in place; CFO signs off monthly but does not review individual records

Conflicting Capability 1: View all security event logs and SIEM alerts across all systems
Conflicting Capability 2: Modify SIEM alert rules thresholds and suppression logic
Conflict Type: Detection & Alert Manipulation - ability to view events and suppress future detection of similar activity
Compensating Control: Peer review required for any changes to alert rules; changes must be documented in Jira with CISO notification
Resolution Required: Monitor - Peer review is adequate compensating control
